title: Ondo legal footer
description: A plain white footer in three layers: six narrow link columns (ink headings, grey links, small arrows on outside links; two-up on phones), then the fine print in two halves under hairlines in 12px grey, then a full-width bar with the company name and year, two legal links and small icon links on the right. Links darken to ink on hover.
notes: social icons are passed in (e.g. lucide icons); the original's brand marks are not reproduced
